```bash
set -e
BASE=http://localhost:8081/api/tickets

curl -sS -X POST "$BASE" -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"title":"Cannot reset password","description":"User gets 500 on reset link.","priority":"HIGH"}' > /tmp/t1.json
curl -sS -X POST "$BASE" -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"title":"Login timeout","description":"Session expires too fast.","priority":"LOW"}' > /tmp/t2.json
curl -sS -X POST "$BASE" -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"title":"Billing invoice","description":"Wrong amount on invoice.","priority":"MEDIUM"}' > /tmp/t3.json

ID2=$(python3 -c "import json; print(json.load(open('/tmp/t2.json'))['id'])")
curl -sS -X POST "$BASE/$ID2/transition" -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"status":"IN_PROGRESS"}' > /dev/null

echo "=== q=password ==="
curl -sS "$BASE?q=password" | python3 -c "import sys,json; d=json.load(sys.stdin); print('total', d['totalElements'], [x['title'] for x in d['content']])"

echo "=== q=invoice (description) ==="
curl -sS "$BASE?q=invoice" | python3 -c "import sys,json; d=json.load(sys.stdin); print('total', d['totalElements'], [x['title'] for x in d['content']])"

echo "=== status=OPEN ==="
curl -sS "$BASE?status=OPEN" | python3 -c "import sys,json; d=json.load(sys.stdin); print('total', d['totalElements'], [(x['title'], x['status']) for x in d['content']])"

echo "=== q=password&status=OPEN ==="
curl -sS "$BASE?q=password&status=OPEN" | python3 -c "import sys,json; d=json.load(sys.stdin); print('total', d['totalElements'], [(x['title'], x['status']) for x in d['content']])"

echo "=== q=password&status=IN_PROGRESS (AND empty) ==="
curl -sS "$BASE?q=password&status=IN_PROGRESS" | python3 -c "import sys,json; d=json.load(sys.stdin); print('total', d['totalElements'])"

echo "=== empty q ==="
curl -sS "$BASE?q=%20%20" | python3 -c "import sys,json; d=json.load(sys.stdin); print('total', d['totalElements'])"

echo "=== bad status HTTP ==="
curl -sS -o /tmp/bad.json -w "%{http_code}" "$BASE?status=NOPE"; echo
cat /tmp/bad.json; echo

echo "=== bad sort HTTP ==="
curl -sS -o /tmp/badsort.json -w "%{http_code}" "$BASE?sort=title,asc"; echo
cat /tmp/badsort.json; echo

echo "=== size=101 HTTP ==="
curl -sS -o /tmp/badsize.json -w "%{http_code}" "$BASE?size=101"; echo
```
